ethics.rule: Ethics is assessed across the call and is not converted into an extra five points.

documents.title: Authority Closers Objection & Decision Intelligence V1.0

evaluation_prompt: Use only supplied source-linked transcript, timing, verified context and permitted signals. For each finding cite exact evidence and state behavior, significance and uncertainty. Judge the achieved objective, not literal wording, question count or order. Use unknown, insufficient_evidence, not_applicable or conflicted when no legitimate opportunity exists. Ethics is a cross-call hard constraint. Never infer fixed personality, character, motive, speaker identity or stable tonality; speaker labels are uncertain without adjudication. Return a nonnumeric research draft with no official grade or endorsement.

context_exceptions.rule: Treat price as a hypothesis. State it clearly, allow reaction, then diagnose whether the barrier is budget, value, comparison, trust, certainty or timing before responding.
Do not assume a partner or decision-maker statement is evasive. Establish whether involvement is genuine, invite the decision-maker when appropriate, and diagnose a different barrier if one appears.
A specific future date with a genuine reason, clear desire, fit and certainty may be successful decision management. Do not manufacture a deadline or offer constraint.

Push only when the prospect is qualified, fit is genuine, uncertainty is addressable and the barrier is not a genuine rejection. Back off when fit, affordability, timing or willingness make continued pressure inappropriate.

Silence after an important question, price, emotional disclosure, objection or decision question is not automatically a defect. An interruption may be useful when a talkative or off-topic prospect needs respectful guidance; impatience is a defect.

Do not require exact questions, exact words, a fixed order or every framework step when the underlying objective was achieved through natural conversation. Do not reward script completion without understanding.

evidence_policy.speaker_identity: Use speaker labels only as uncertain attribution unless independently adjudicated; never infer identity from voice.
evidence_policy.tonality_inference: Describe observed pacing, pauses, overlap or composure only when the permitted audio or timing evidence supports it; do not infer a fixed trait or personality.

report_sections.title: SCORECARD
report_sections.required: Eight withheld dimensions; Ethics PASS/CONCERN/FAIL hard constraint.

report_sections.title: TOP 3 IMPROVEMENTS
report_sections.required: At most three behavioral changes with evidence.

report_sections.title: OBJECTION ANALYSIS
report_sections.required: Stated/likely objection, uncertainty, evidence, handling and next move.

report_sections.title: CLOSING ANALYSIS
report_sections.required: Readiness, ask, confidence and next step; future date/no when relevant.

report_sections.title: FINAL VERDICT
report_sections.required: Nonnumeric conclusion with evidence gaps and ethics state.
